title: EPIC — Café website (demo build, no real business involved)
desc: A TEST OF LARGER WORK. Target: a static café site in projects/cafe-site/ — index.html, styles.css, menu.json, app.js, README.md. ACCEPTANCE (checked on this epic before it can go done): opens offline from file:// with zero network requests; every menu item comes from menu.json, none hardcoded in HTML; usable at 360px and 1440px; keyboard-navigable with visible focus; no external fonts/images/scripts; README says how to view it. RULES: one child = one branch + one PR, reviewed by an agent who did not write it; coordinate the DOM/JSON interface on the bus in ONE short message before coding, so the three children can run in parallel; product code goes in projects/, never in bin/. The agent who finishes the LAST child runs the acceptance checklist and moves this epic to review.
